pages.empty: EmptyState: 'Noch keine Kontakte.' / 'Kontakte sind Personen und Firmen, mit denen ihr zu tun habt: Mitglieder, Gäste, Partner. Lege den ersten an oder importiere eine Liste.' + button 'Neuer Kontakt'. Filtered: 'Keine Kontakte gefunden.' Trash: 'Der Papierkorb ist leer.'
pages.phone: DataTable as cards (no tick boxes, so no bulk bar); primary as round + next to tab bar.
uxNotes: Empty state mentions importing, but its only button is 'Neuer Kontakt'; import is hidden in the ⋯ menu.
Bulk tag uses a free-text Input + datalist instead of <TagSelect> used everywhere else for tags.
Bulk export is xlsx only, while the header export offers xlsx and CSV.
No sort options; list sorted by last name, first name, company.
Trash view rows still link to the contact page; restore happens there (no restore button in the list), unlike /forms trash which restores inline.
Email/phone cells in the list are plain text, not mailto:/tel: (row is a link).

redesign.job: Find a person fast (search, tag), open them; now and then import, export, tag or trash many.
redesign.phone: Top bar: Kontakte, ⋯ (Importieren, Exportieren, Papierkorb), round + = Neuer Kontakt. Toolbar: search full width, then the Tags filter in the scroll row. Cards: name (+ company) as title, email · phone as muted lines. Empty: EmptyState with Neuer Kontakt + Importieren.
redesign.desktop: <ListToolbar> search · Tags. Table: Name (+ company), E-Mail, Telefon, Ort, Tags. Tick boxes → bulk bar: tags via <TagSelect> (add / remove), Exportieren, In den Papierkorb (confirm).

pages.phone: RecordLayout stacks: the form and timeline first, the aside cards (team, membership, tickets, …, files) below them.
uxNotes: Related-record cards (membership, tickets, invoices…) are in the aside, which on phones comes after the whole edit form + timeline – far down for the 'look someone up' flow.
Ticket rows link to the event's ticket list, email rows to the unfiltered send log – neither opens the actual record.
Note deletion has no confirm; contact trash does.
Membership link goes through a legacy redirect (/members?new=1&contact=) instead of /members/new?contact= directly.
No way to create an invoice, ticket or membership from here other than the membership button and 'Brief erstellen'.
Uses NativeSelect for the team picker instead of a server-search picker.

redesign.job: The Person hub: who is this (status, tags, how to reach them) and everything connected to them in the modules that are on; act from here (mail, call, invoice, membership, letter).
redesign.phone: Top bar: ‹ Kontakte · name, ⋯ (E-Mail, Anrufen, Neue Rechnung, Als Mitglied aufnehmen, Brief erstellen, Papierkorb). Header: status badges (Mitglied / Ehemaliges Mitglied, Team, Abgemeldet) + meta (company, tags). Round button = Bearbeiten (sheet). Then Kontaktdaten (DetailList: email mailto, phone tel, address, birthday, custom fields), then the connections as sections with <LinkRows> (Mitgliedschaft + open dues, Tickets & Gästelisten, Bestellungen, Rechnungen & Angebote, Zahlungen, Kurse, Vermietung, Formulare, E-Mails, Schichten & Personal), Dateien, Teamzugang, Verlauf (note form + timeline) last.
redesign.desktop: RecordLayout: left = Kontaktdaten + connections + Dateien; right = Teamzugang + Verlauf (activity column like Attio/HubSpot). Header: E-Mail, Anrufen (outline), ⋯, primary Bearbeiten → ?edit=details sheet with the grouped ContactForm + SaveBar.

research: HubSpot / Attio / Folk: a contact opens on identity (name, company, tags) with quick actions (email, call) and the person's properties in a compact list; associations (deals, tickets, companies) as small linked lists; activity as its own column/tab; editing properties happens inline or in a panel, never as the page body. Taken: header identity + status chips, Kontaktdaten as a fact list, every module as a short linked list, activity on the right, editing in a sheet.
